prime.label: Bank prime loan rate
prime.source: FRB H.15 (MPRIME) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

m2_own.label: M2 own rate
m2_own.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, M2 own rate (M2OWN) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

dep_cost_qbp.label: Effective deposit cost (FDIC, all insured institutions)
dep_cost_qbp.source: FDIC, Quarterly Banking Profile (all FDIC-insured institutions) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation
dep_cost_qbp.method: 400 × interest expense on deposits of the quarter / average deposits (end of quarter and previous quarter)

dep_cost_fdic_cb.label: Effective deposit cost (FDIC, insured commercial banks, annual)
dep_cost_fdic_cb.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation
dep_cost_fdic_cb.method: 100 × interest expense on deposits / average deposits (end of year and previous year)

rd_nominal.label: Deposit rate (M2 own rate to 2019Q2, then FDIC deposit cost)
rd_nominal.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation
rd_nominal.method: M2 own rate to 2019 Q2, then dep_cost_qbp

infl_cpi.label: CPI-U inflation, year on year
infl_cpi.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, CPI-U (CPIAUCSL) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

g_real.label: Real GDP growth, year on year
g_real.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, real GDP (GDPC1) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

rd_minus_g.label: Real deposit rate minus real GDP growth
rd_minus_g.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rd_m2own_minus_g.label: Real deposit rate minus growth, M2 own rate (to 2019Q2)
rd_m2own_minus_g.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rd_fdic_minus_g.label: Real deposit rate minus growth, FDIC deposit cost
rd_fdic_minus_g.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rl_minus_g_gross.label: Real loan rate minus growth, before costs
rl_minus_g_gross.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rl_minus_g.label: Real loan rate minus growth, after costs (gross costs)
rl_minus_g.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rl_minus_g_net.label: Real loan rate minus growth, after costs (net of noninterest income)
rl_minus_g_net.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

spread_l_d.label: Loan–deposit spread after costs (gross costs)
spread_l_d.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

spread_l_d_net.label: Loan–deposit spread after costs (net costs)
spread_l_d_net.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

m2_gdp.label: M2 / nominal GDP
m2_gdp.source: Board of Governors, M2 (M2SL); BEA, GDP via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation
m2_gdp.method: quarterly average of M2 / nominal GDP at an annual rate

bank_lev_h8.label: Bank leverage, H.8: total liabilities / residual
bank_lev_h8.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.8 (all commercial banks, not seasonally adjusted) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation
bank_lev_h8.method: quarterly average of weekly total liabilities / quarterly average of weekly residual

bank_lev_qbp.label: Bank leverage, FDIC QBP: liabilities / equity
bank_lev_qbp.source: FDIC, Quarterly Banking Profile (all FDIC-insured institutions) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

bank_lev_fdic.label: Bank leverage, FDIC: total liabilities / equity capital
bank_lev_fdic.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation
bank_lev_fdic.method: total liabilities / equity capital, end of year

bank_roe.label: Bank return on equity (FDIC), nominal
bank_roe.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation
bank_roe.method: 100 × net income / average equity (end of year and previous year)

bank_roe_real_g.label: Bank return on equity minus inflation and growth
bank_roe_real_g.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation
bank_roe_real_g.method: bank_roe − annual means of infl_cpi and g_real

bank_roe_qbp.label: Bank return on equity (FDIC QBP), nominal
bank_roe_qbp.source: FDIC, Quarterly Banking Profile (all FDIC-insured institutions) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation
bank_roe_qbp.method: 400 × net income of the quarter / average equity

cost_assets_gross.label: Noninterest expense / average assets (FDIC)
cost_assets_gross.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation

cost_assets_net.label: Noninterest expense less noninterest income / average assets (FDIC)
cost_assets_net.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation

cost_assets_gross_qbp.label: Noninterest expense / average assets (FDIC QBP)
cost_assets_gross_qbp.source: FDIC, Quarterly Banking Profile (all FDIC-insured institutions) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation
cost_assets_gross_qbp.method: 400 × noninterest expense of the quarter / average assets

cost_assets_net_qbp.label: Net noninterest expense / average assets (FDIC QBP)
cost_assets_net_qbp.source: FDIC, Quarterly Banking Profile (all FDIC-insured institutions) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation
cost_assets_net_qbp.method: 400 × (noninterest expense − noninterest income) of the quarter / average assets

corp_lev_z1_bv.label: Nonfinancial corporate debt / net worth, book (historical cost)
corp_lev_z1_bv.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), B.103 via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

corp_lev_z1_mv.label: Nonfinancial corporate debt / net worth, market value
corp_lev_z1_mv.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), B.103 via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

fdic_assets.label: Total assets (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_assets.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_liab.label: Total liabilities (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_liab.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_equity.label: Total equity capital (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_equity.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_net_income.label: Net income (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_net_income.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_nonint_exp.label: Total noninterest expense (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_nonint_exp.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_nonint_inc.label: Total noninterest income (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_nonint_inc.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_dep_int.label: Interest expense on deposits (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_dep_int.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

fdic_deposits.label: Total deposits (FDIC-insured commercial banks)
fdic_deposits.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API

ref_an_lev.label: Aoki–Nikolov: 10
ref_an_lev.source: Aoki, K. and K. Nikolov (2015), Bubbles, banks and financial stability, Journal of Monetary Economics 74, 33–51, Table 1
ref_an_lev.method: constant: value of Aoki and Nikolov (2015, Table 1)

ref_an_roe.label: Aoki–Nikolov: 10%
ref_an_roe.source: Aoki, K. and K. Nikolov (2015), Bubbles, banks and financial stability, Journal of Monetary Economics 74, 33–51, Table 1
ref_an_roe.method: constant: value of Aoki and Nikolov (2015, Table 1)

ref_an_m2.label: Aoki–Nikolov: 0.50
ref_an_m2.source: Aoki, K. and K. Nikolov (2015), Bubbles, banks and financial stability, Journal of Monetary Economics 74, 33–51, Table 1
ref_an_m2.method: constant: value of Aoki and Nikolov (2015, Table 1)

ref_an_corp.label: Aoki–Nikolov: 0.50
ref_an_corp.source: Aoki, K. and K. Nikolov (2015), Bubbles, banks and financial stability, Journal of Monetary Economics 74, 33–51, Table 1
ref_an_corp.method: constant: value of Aoki and Nikolov (2015, Table 1)

rd_minus_g_mean_rep.label: Mean 1959–2012, deposit rate
rd_minus_g_mean_rep.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation
rd_minus_g_mean_rep.method: mean of rd_minus_g over 1959 Q1–2012 Q4 (null outside)

rl_minus_g_gross_mean_rep.label: Mean 1959–2012, loan rate before costs
rl_minus_g_gross_mean_rep.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation
rl_minus_g_gross_mean_rep.method: mean of rl_minus_g_gross over 1959 Q1–2012 Q4 (null outside)

rl_minus_g_mean_rep.label: Mean 1959–2012, loan rate after costs
rl_minus_g_mean_rep.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation
rl_minus_g_mean_rep.method: mean of rl_minus_g over 1959 Q1–2012 Q4 (null outside)

rows.name: Real deposit rate minus real GDP growth (R^d)
rows.method: M2 own rate (to 2019Q2, then FDIC effective deposit cost) − CPI-U inflation (y/y) − real GDP growth (y/y), quarterly, sample mean
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Real deposit rate minus growth, M2 own rate only (AN's source; ends 2019Q2)
rows.method: M2 own rate − CPI-U inflation − real GDP growth
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Real deposit rate minus growth, FDIC deposit cost throughout (from 1984)
rows.method: FDIC interest expense on deposits / average deposits (QBP, all insured institutions) − inflation − growth
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Real loan rate minus growth, before intermediation costs
rows.method: prime rate − CPI-U inflation − real GDP growth
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Real loan rate minus growth, after costs (R^l; gross costs)
rows.method: prime rate − inflation − growth − FDIC noninterest expense / average assets (annual, commercial banks)
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Real loan rate minus growth, after costs net of noninterest income
rows.method: as above, with (noninterest expense − noninterest income) / average assets
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Loan–deposit spread after costs, R^l − R^d (gross costs)
rows.method: rl_minus_g − rd_minus_g; AN's data imply 3.2 pp (0.982 − 0.950)
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Loan–deposit spread after costs (net costs)
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Deposits / GDP: M2 / nominal GDP (D/Y)
rows.method: quarterly average of M2 / nominal GDP at an annual rate
rows.source: Board of Governors, M2 (M2SL); BEA, GDP via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

rows.name: Bank leverage, H.8 (D/N): total liabilities / residual (assets less liabilities)
rows.method: quarterly averages of weekly H.8 data, all commercial banks, NSA; ratio of the averages
rows.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.8 (all commercial banks, not seasonally adjusted) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

rows.name: Bank leverage, FDIC (D/N): total liabilities / total equity capital
rows.method: end of year, insured commercial banks (equity = assets − liabilities before 1984)
rows.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation

rows.name: Bank return on equity, nominal (FDIC)
rows.method: net income / average equity capital (years t and t − 1)
rows.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation

rows.name: Bank return on equity minus inflation and growth (model units; brief K10)
rows.method: bank_roe − CPI-U inflation − real GDP growth (annual means of the quarters)
rows.source: FRED (FRB H.15, M2 own rate, BLS CPI-U, BEA GDP), FDIC; author's calculation

rows.name: Intermediation costs / assets, gross (FDIC)
rows.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation

rows.name: Intermediation costs / assets, net of noninterest income (FDIC)
rows.source: FDIC, Historical Statistics on Banking (FDIC-insured commercial banks), BankFind API; author's calculation

rows.name: Average corporate leverage (L/Z), Z.1 debt / net worth at book value
rows.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), B.103 via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

rows.name: Average corporate leverage (L/Z), Z.1 debt / net worth at market value
rows.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), B.103 via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

rows.name: Leverage of indebted corporates (L/(sZ))
rows.method: not computed: needs firm-level Compustat data (Welch 2004), which the site cannot republish
rows.source: Aoki, K. and K. Nikolov (2015), Bubbles, banks and financial stability, Journal of Monetary Economics 74, 33–51, Table 1, from Welch, I. (2004), Capital structure and stock returns, Journal of Political Economy 112(1), 106–131
rows.note: AN's value kept as an external target (Arthur, 27 Nov 2026: no Compustat access).

crisis_frequency.about: Stage 1 of the calibration of π (bubble survival, decision D7): the annual frequency of systemic banking or financial crises, crises started / years observed, and 1 − frequency. A burst of the model's bubble is not one-to-one with a measured crisis: these are inputs, not a calibration.
